create_struct_of_array_dataclass: decorate a dataclass with StructOfArray to enable JAX pytree flattening and array field validation
slice_struct_of_array_instance: index a StructOfArray instance with get_item to slice all array fields by the same key
validate_struct_of_array_shapes: run post_init to validate that all array fields share matching shapes and dtypes
flatten_struct_of_array_for_jax: use flatten to convert a StructOfArray instance into flat arrays and metadata for JAX transformations
replace_struct_of_array_fields: call replace on a StructOfArray instance to create a new frozen copy with updated field values
